review.why: Converts Word, slides, sheets, RTF, EPUB and text PDFs to Markdown locally, with safe handling of file paths.
review.summary: Uses the anydoc CLI inside the agent container to convert an attached document to Markdown. It shows how to quote untrusted file paths safely, prefers writing to a file, treats document content as data, and lists limits (no OCR, lossy spreadsheets, flattened nested tables).
strengths: Shell-safe path quoting with a worked example
Local conversion by default; no upload without authorization
Documents are treated as untrusted data
cautions: Tied to a container layout (/workspace paths) and the anydoc CLI
Spreadsheet formatting and nested tables are lossy
